header: Amazon Q Developer for Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Amazon Q Developer is a generative AI-powered assistant that helps developers and IT
professionals perform a variety of tasks throughout the software development lifecycle. Amazon
Q helps AWS customers code, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and optimize their applications running in
AWS.
Amazon Q integration with Amazon OpenSearch Service oﬀers the following generative
capabilities:
• the section called “Generate visualizations using natural language”
• the section called “View alert summaries and insights”
• the section called “View Amazon Q-generated query result summaries on the Discover page”
• the section called “View recommended anomaly detectors”
• the section called “Access Amazon Q chat for OpenSearch Service questions”
To access Amazon Q Developer features in OpenSearch Service that are relevant to your task, look
for the following in-context icon on the Alerts, Discover, and Create visualization pages. Click the
icon to prompt for assistance and use the features described in this section.
You can also chat directly with Amazon Q by clicking the icon in the top-right corner of the
OpenSearch Service console. Amazon Q chat supports answers to questions about OpenSearch
Service features and functionality.
Note
Amazon Q chat can't access your data. For this reason, you can't engage the chatbot in a
conversation about your data.
For more information about Amazon Q, see What is Amazon Q Developer? in the Amazon Q User
Guide.
